fd9cbadd5def8c4e1d0389a6107d5c187865b921.definition: งานที่บุคคลทำเพื่อคงตำแหน่ง ความเคารพ และชื่อเสียงของตนไว้ในกลุ่ม มักปรากฏเป็นพฤติกรรมที่ทำอย่างตั้งใจ
fd9cbadd5def8c4e1d0389a6107d5c187865b921.gloss: การรักษาสถานะและตำแหน่งของตนในกลุ่ม

fd9cbadd5def8c4e1d0389a6107d5c187865b921.definition: Bir kişinin grup içindeki yerini ve saygınlığını korumak için yaptığı bilinçli çalışma. Bu çalışma, davranışların başkaları üzerindeki etkisini gözetmeyi de içerir.
fd9cbadd5def8c4e1d0389a6107d5c187865b921.gloss: Toplumsal konumunu ve saygınlığını koruma çalışması.

fd9cbadd5def8c4e1d0389a6107d5c187865b921.translation: Raporu iki kez okumasının nedeni, toplumsal konumunu koruma çabasıydı.
เธออ่านรายงานซ้ำสองรอบก่อนส่ง เพราะต้องการรักษาสถานะของตัวเองในกลุ่ม
Pemeliharaan status membuatnya membaca laporan dua kali sebelum mengirimnya.
A manutenção de status é a razão de ela reler o relatório duas vezes antes de enviá-lo.
보고서를 두 번이나 읽은 이유가 바로 지위 유지였기 때문이다.
報告書を二度読んでから送ったのは、彼女が集団内での立場を保つためだった。

fd9cbadd5def8c4e1d0389a6107d5c187865b921.text: Status maintenance is why she read the report twice before she sent it.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.definition: A set of things you do in the same order every time. A bedtime routine helps your body get sleepy.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.gloss: A set of things you do in the same order every time. A bedtime routine helps your body get sleepy.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.definition: 寝かしつけや朝の準備など、毎回同じ順番で行う一連の行動。特定の場面での習慣を指す。
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.gloss: いつも同じ順番で行う一連の行動。

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.definition: 늘 같은 순서로 진행하는 일이나 절차이다. 잠자리 전에는 이를 치고 양치를 하는 일처럼 몸에helpful한 습관도 포함한다.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.gloss: 매일 같은 순서로 정해진 일들을 뜻한다.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.definition: É um conjunto de coisas feitas repetidamente e em ordem semelhante. Uma rotina de dormir, por exemplo, ajuda o corpo a ficar com sono.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.gloss: Sequência de atividadesacciadas sempre na mesma ordem.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.definition: Rutinitas adalah kegiatan yang dilakukan secara teratur dan berulang. Rutinitas sebelum tidur dapat membantu tubuh menjadienic.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.gloss: Rangkaian kegiatan yang dilakukan dengan urutan yang sama setiap kali.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.definition: กิจวัตรคือกิจกรรมชุดหนึ่งที่ทำตามลำดับและเวลาเดิมอย่างสม่ำเสมอ กิจวัตรก่อนนอนช่วยให้ร่างกายเริ่มรู้สึกง่วง
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.gloss: กิจวัตรคือการกระทำชุดหนึ่งที่ทำตามลำดับเดิมทุกครั้ง

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.definition: Bir kişinin düzenli olarak ve aynı sırayla yaptığı işlerdir. Yatma öncesi rutini, çocuğun uykuya geçmesine yardımcı olur.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.gloss: Her zaman aynı sırayla yapılan işler dizisi.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.text: Our bedtime routine is the same every night.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.translation: Yatma öncesi rutinimiz her gece aynıdır.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.text: Our bedtime routine is the same every night.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.translation: กิจวัตรก่อนนอนของเราเหมือนเดิมทุกคืน

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.text: Our bedtime routine is the same every night.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.translation: Rutinitas sebelum tidur kami selalu sama setiap malam.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.text: Our bedtime routine is the same every night.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.translation: Nossa rotina antes de dormir é a mesma todas as noites.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.text: Our bedtime routine is the same every night.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.translation: 우리 집의 잠자리 전 습관은 매일 같다.

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.text: Our bedtime routine is the same every night.
fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.translation: 寝る前のルーティンは、今夜もいつもどおりだ。

fde55b36ec36cbcd2832b6b9f8f59ea0cf6d942c.text: Our bedtime routine is the same every night.

fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.definition: The text a model learns from. Its range and its quality decide what the model is good at and what it never saw.
fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.gloss: The text a model learns from. Its range and its quality decide what the model is good at and what it never saw.

fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.definition: モデルの学習，用来データ。データの種類と質が、モデルの得意分野や学習していない領域を左右する。
fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.gloss: モデルが学習する文章のこと。

fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.definition: 학습 자료의 범위와 품질이 모델이 잘하는 분야와 보지 못한 내용을 결정합니다. 특정 언어나 주제가 충분히 포함되지 않으면 그쪽에 대한 성능이 낮아질 수 있습니다.
Conjunto de textos, imagens ou outros dados usados para ensinar um modelo. A variedade e a qualidade desses dados influenciam o que o modelo aprende e em que situações ele pode ter Bom desempenho.
fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.gloss: O texto que um modelo aprende durante o treinamento.

fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.definition: Teks yang dipelajari sebuah model bahasa atau sistem kecerdasan buatan. Cakupannya yang luas atau sempit serta mutunya yang tinggi atau rendah menentukan apa yangdikuasai model dan apa yang tidak pernah dilihatnya.
fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.gloss: Teks yang dipelajari sebuah model, yang cakupannya dan mutunya menentukan kemampuan model tersebut.

fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.definition: ข้อมูลการฝึกคือข้อมูลตัวอย่างที่โมเดลใช้เรียนรู้ ทั้งความหลากหลายและคุณภาพของข้อมูลมีผลต่อสิ่งที่โมเดลทำได้ดีและสิ่งที่โมเดลไม่เคยพบ
fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.gloss: ข้อมูลที่โมเดลใช้เรียนรู้

fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.definition: Eğitim verisinin kapsamı ve kalitesi, modelin hangi konularda başarılı olacağını ve neleri hiç görmediğini belirler. Veri ne kadar geniş ve çeşitliyse modelin o kadar geniş bir alanda öğrenebilmesi beklenir.

fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.translation: Eğitim verisi çoğunlukla İngilizce web sayfalarından oluşuyorsa model İngilizceyi en iyi yanıtlar.
หากข้อมูลการฝึกส่วนใหญ่เป็นเว็บไซต์ภาษาอังกฤษ โมเดลจะตอบภาษาอังกฤษได้ดีที่สุด
Jika data pelatihan sebagian besar berupa halaman web berbahasa Inggris, model itu paling mahir menjawab dalam bahasa Inggris.
Se os dados de treinamento eram principalmente páginas da web em inglês, o modelo responderá melhor em inglês.
학습 데이터가 대부분 영어 웹페이지였다면 모델은 영어로 가장 자연스럽게 답했습니다.
学習データが主に英語のウェブページなら、モデルは英語で最もよく回答する。

fdfe0102a999b8747566b54f2ea0df9b26156742.text: If the training data was mostly English web pages, the model will answer English best.
